findings.title: FROZEN gate forbids the contract's amendments; no state lets C2 pass
findings.evidence: frozen-gate.sh: FROZEN_UNCHANGED=0 when contract.json+c2/measure.py are amended (r8); c2 counter reads REV bytes so uncommitted amendments never run; freeze.json at rev has amendments=[]
findings.smallest_safe_correction: re-anchor at a new freeze commit carrying the amended bytes and a regenerated manifest, and pass that commit as FREEZE; keep 631cd645 as the superseded freeze

findings.title: frozen C2 counter cannot pass C2 and its own before receipt is not reproducible
findings.evidence: counter run from 631cd645 bytes at base: usable=12/13 total=19 PASS=false vs frozen receipt usable=13/13 total=18; registry-check plain rc=0 vs strace rc=1, reproduced 3/3
findings.smallest_safe_correction: apply amendment 4 under a new freeze (plain rc; trace only for the /tmp census) and re-derive the before receipt; absent a re-freeze report C2 as a counter defect (miss)

findings.title: working-tree freeze.json re-derives from no revision
findings.evidence: contract entry ed6871e1 = contract with exactly 3 amendments; worktree contract now 5 amendments (5de4f37b); no such blob in the object DB
findings.smallest_safe_correction: regenerate the manifest in the same commit as the bytes and re-derive all entries from that commit

findings.title: verdict grep reads the working tree; assume-unchanged hides drift
findings.evidence: fix6: REV blob 1 byte, worktree verdict, git status empty, gate opens
findings.smallest_safe_correction: grep the receipt extracted from REV; refuse when git ls-files -v shows assume-unchanged/skip-worktree

findings.evidence: OUT named .* hides ?? junkfile and the gate opens

findings.title: FREEZE is caller-supplied and unconstrained; FREEZE=REV self-certifies
findings.evidence: gate opens and FROZEN_UNCHANGED=1 with FREEZE=REV (r13); no FREEZE!=REV, no ancestor-of-BASE check, no pin to the contract freeze
findings.smallest_safe_correction: take FREEZE from the contract or a fixed constant and refuse unless FREEZE is an ancestor of BASE and FREEZE != REV
